sql: SELECT "articles"."artkey" AS k, ("articles"."accscore" - "articles"."contrscore") AS m1 FROM "articles" WHERE ("articles"."accscore" - "articles"."contrscore") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: accessibility score - controversy score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same article
rank articles rows by accessibility score minus controversy score

sql: SELECT "systemperformance"."rectrace" AS k, ("systemperformance"."loadscore" - "systemperformance"."perfscore") AS m1 FROM "systemperformance" WHERE ("systemperformance"."loadscore" - "systemperformance"."perfscore") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: systemperformance.system load score minus system performance score
why: system load score - system performance score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same performance log record
rank systemperformance rows by system load score minus system performance score

sql: SELECT "sessions"."seshkey" AS k, (CAST("sessions"."bncrate" AS REAL) / "sessions"."seshdepth") AS m1 FROM "sessions" WHERE (CAST("sessions"."bncrate" AS REAL) / "sessions"."seshdepth") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: bounce rate / navigation depth: the catalogue declares bounce rate part of navigation depth
rank sessions rows by bounce rate per navigation depth
